task_type: public discovery resilience repair and production release
goal: Vacation, holiday and spa discovery rails must show useful truthful content immediately, self-heal availability in the background and never remain as a long-lived skeleton or empty retry box.

requirements.statement: A first visitor receives useful cards without waiting on the availability provider.
requirements.acceptance_check: Cold provider failure returns HTTP 200 catalog fallback and the UI renders cards, not a skeleton or error-only panel.

requirements.statement: Fallback cards must not claim dated availability or a live price.
requirements.acceptance_check: Fallback projections contain catalog facts only and UI labels availability as updating/background checked.

requirements.statement: Availability refresh continues outside the visitor response and can populate the durable cache.
requirements.acceptance_check: Each cold route schedules its bounded refresh through the request execution context.

requirements.statement: Near vacation, holiday vacation and spa package rails behave consistently on mobile and desktop.
requirements.acceptance_check: Focused tests, production build and exact public release checks cover all three APIs and the homepage at desktop and mobile widths.

requirements.statement: Publish the verified fix to the public VII site.
requirements.acceptance_check: One exact Sites version is deployed with rollback identity and direct public verification.

predicted_rejections: The loader is bounded but a first visitor still sees no content.
A catalog fallback is mislabeled as verified availability.
One rail is fixed while another shared availability rail still fails.
The local fix is not the exact version published publicly.
rollback: Redeploy public Sites release 558 if the candidate fails post-deploy checks.
